todos: [P0] Make Agent Coding cancellation and rollback transactional across direct file tools, commands, package managers, generators, downloads, and Git, preferably through a disposable worktree per run.
[P1] Implement task-scoped ingestion cancellation across Renderer, Main, and sidecar with task IDs, cancellation tokens, and transactional cleanup.
[P1] Make the Ollama host explicit and immutable for every pull, delete, and generation request; handle HTTPS deliberately and test concurrent hosts.
[P1] Replace singleton Ollama stream cancellation with operation-scoped IDs and expose queued generation state.
[P1] Preserve Ollama generation failures across IPC; prevent chat and translation from reporting or exporting false success.
[P1] Make sidecar health fail closed on malformed responses, probe errors, timeouts, and process exit.
[P1] Fix unknown-model context fallback so hardware capacity is not clamped to 2048 tokens and restore the failing context-ceiling tests.
[P1] Return the Agent Coding run ID and queue position when accepting work; cancel one run by ID instead of falling back to cancelAll.
[P1] Separate conversation history from per-run execution state; resume only matching interrupted runs and reset step, recovery, and milestone budgets for new prompts.
[P1] Persist Agent Coding logs and prompt queues atomically per conversation; remove reliance on asynchronous beforeunload writes and stale renderer state.
[P1] Replace the ignored contextFiles payload with one validated activeFile contract containing path, content, and version hash across Renderer, IPC, and prompt assembly.
[P1] Make plan generation and interview runs cancellable, bind them to immutable run identity, block duplicate starts, and expose their queued, running, cancelling, and failed states.

[P1] Propagate one run AbortSignal through model streaming, tools, final verification, timeout handling, and the persistent shell; suppress events after terminal completion and recreate killed shells safely.
[P1] Add an Agent Coding preflight for Ollama reachability, exact installed model, model qualification, context capacity, workspace writability, toolchain availability, and workspace trust.
[P1] Default Agent Coding to a finite safe capability profile and expose file, terminal, network, and step-budget controls in onboarding and per-run review.
[P1] Replace regex-only command blocking with structured command validation or PowerShell AST inspection, workspace confinement, and mandatory approval for destructive operations.
[P1] Bind execution and progress events to the approved planRevisionId so running an older plan cannot update the latest revision.
[P1] Collapse mutation and network gates into one contextual approval with one consent ID so Ask mode never prompts twice for the same action.
[P1] Make standalone Agent Coding use a visible first-class scratch workspace with reveal, export, persistence, and cleanup controls.

[P1] Add Electron end-to-end scenarios for project and session switching, queued prompts, cancellation in every phase, crash resume, dirty Git, stale editor saves, missing models, standalone artifacts, spaced paths, and symlink escapes.
[P1] Simplify Agent Coding into read-only Ask, default Guided review, and trusted local Auto modes; make planning an automatic stage for complex work and use one primary action.
[P2] Respect document deletion failures before mutating renderer state and surface an actionable error.
[P2] Preserve the actual imported file type across ingest, update, and list responses so DOCX translation eligibility stays consistent.
[P2] Show remote Ollama recovery actions in remote mode instead of offering local installation or launch.
[P2] Replace the estimated Agent Coding context meter with the backend prompt budget breakdown and make Compact reduce backend context without deleting the visible audit timeline.
[P2] Default Agent Coding debug logs to metadata only; require opt-in for prompt and source payloads and add retention and clear controls.
[P2] Show a final Agent Coding evidence card with changed files, verification results, cancellation status, and any effects that could not be rolled back.
